statement: Adaptive-trigger resistance/mode semantics and physically measured actuator response of a genuine DualSense have not been established from EXP-0015; its owner reports damaged trigger modules and did not actuate them.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: HID output fields and application APIs are not physical performance validation.
